population.selection: all rows; no error, support, confidence, transition, or annotation filtering

observations.crop: 1.25x actor crop, 384 letterbox, ImageNet normalization, DINOv2-base patch14 27x27
observations.source_availability: finite positive supplied box, valid_geometry, image_present, allowlisted ZIP member CRC and bytes; ignore annotation_occluded and annotation_generated
observations.missing: zero contrast and zero common coverage; retain center and context features
observations.corruption: abort; never reinterpret hash, identity, shape, nonfinite, or impossible-geometry failures as missing evidence
observations.dense_precision: DINO last_hidden_state patch tokens cast to float16; matching and interpolation use float32; bin reductions accumulate in float64 and cast to float32 output

decomposition.pooling: 3x2 bins in unexpanded center actor box; patch centers are 14*(index+.5) in letterbox edge coordinates
decomposition.common_support: per-donor intersection of center ROI/source validity, same-grid four-corner validity, phase-only four-corner validity, and affine four-corner validity
decomposition.aggregation: uniform donor mean per supported target, then uniform target mean per bin
decomposition.coverage: common targets divided by source-valid actor-ROI targets in each bin

reader.scaler: outer-train-only float64 mean and population std; denominator max(std,1e-6); output float32
reader.sampler: For each fold create numpy default_rng(42); repeatedly append rng.permutation(sorted outer-train row indices), and consume consecutive batches of64. Recreate the identical schedule for every arm.

metrics.macro_f1: pooled confusion macro over fixed classes [0,1,2], absent-class F1=0
metrics.brier: mean rowwise sum over three classes
metrics.ece: 15 equal-width bins; bin=min(floor(confidence*15),14); weighted absolute confidence-accuracy gap
metrics.uncertainty: 100000 paired scenario bootstrap draws with numpy default_rng(20260913); sample 11 scenarios with replacement and pool all member rows with multiplicity
metrics.exact_swaps: all 2048 assignments of signs to 11 scenario contributions, descriptive
metrics.outer_fold_macro_f1: fixed three-class macro-F1 separately within each held fold

gates.discovery: B3-B2>=0.005 macro-F1, B3-B0>=0.005, B3-B1>=0.005, B3-B2>0 in every fold, and paired-scenario bootstrap95 lower bound>0
gates.opportunity: B3 rescues at least40 retained-ARFTR errors and either at least10 rescues unique beyond B0/B1/B2, or B3 rescues>=B2, B3 harms<=B2-10, and B3 net corrections>B2 in every fold
gates.confirmation: run locked seeds43 and44 only after discovery passes; opportunity is required before intervention design, not before confirmation
gates.integration: separate fully nested protocol; macro-F1>=0.8588364807373623, net corrections>=25, positive every fold, positive scenario-CI lower bound, class F1 loss<=0.005, NLL/Brier no worse, exact retain audit

evaluation_boundary.task labels: read only by task runner after observation cache is sealed
evaluation_boundary.ARFTR and diagnostic support: read only by post-fit auditor after all20 checkpoint/prediction receipts are sealed
forbidden: global OOF predictions as meta-training rows

requirements: peak memory and stage timings recorded

execution_limit: Do not launch a training command projected above20 minutes; shard extraction and hand off a longer command.
